about: R'th's continent at tile scale, laid out from the land up (docs/world-plan.md; the format is docs/layout.md). Absolute tiles: Tolling's south-west corner is (0, 0), east +x, north +y. Check with `dotnet run --project tools/world -- layout`, see it with `paint`, generate it with `blockout`. p- names are placeholders and never reach players.

relief.note: the range falls sheer to the frontier; the passes come down it on ramps

relief.name: the spine

relief.name: the Scarp

relief.name: an old fall in the Wolds

terrain.about: The generated land's terrain, in tiles (Landscape, docs/world-plan.md). Each ground's height is smoothed into its neighbours'; then the land's rolling, the landforms (relief), the crest's peaks, the fall to the sea, lakes held level, rivers falling to their mouths in valleys of their own, passes, roads levelled across, settlement platforms.
